steps.text: Planning a weekend trip with friends turns into a mess of group chats, links, and half-made plans, and everyone ends up on a different page. I want to launch Trailhead: shape the first experience, write the product brief and UX notes as part of this run, and create one independent, separately shippable work item titled Create Trailhead landing page. That landing page needs a welcome banner, three value props, and one primary Plan my first trip button. Before completing the orchestration, the Coordinator must submit an architectural decision through the native decision tool that records the chosen first-release scope and why.

externalArtifacts.instruction: A repository administrator must manually create the disposable demo issue, add agentweaver:triage, and verify the signed issues.labeled delivery before capture. The capture plan never creates issues, labels, or webhooks.
Set this to the resulting same-project github.issues.labeled run URL after a repository administrator has verified delivery.

pullRequest.instruction: Capture derives the one current Bug Fix pull request from its awaiting-review run topology and verifies that GitHub still reports the same open branch before Beat 4.6 approval. It never creates, approves, or substitutes a pull request.
